name: Slatehouse
summary: An editorial sales CRM for a stone and tile supplier, with client files, deals and a forecast
about: A sales CRM for a team that sells to architects, contractors, developers and homeowners, shown with sample data from a Karachi stone yard. Deal cards carry a cut of their stone, every client has a filing-cabinet folder of documents, samples and notes, and a forecast fan chart shows the best, expected and worst months ahead with a target line you drag.
how: Use the underlined menu under the masthead (a drop-down sheet on phones) to move between the eight pages.
On Deals, drag a stone card to the next stage; dropping it on Ordered books it. Keyboard users press Shift with an arrow key or use the grip.
On Client files, open a folder and switch between Documents, Samples, Projects and Notes; tick off samples as they are posted.
On Forecast, move the win rate, deal size, slip and uncertainty sliders to reshape the fan, and drag the green handle (or use the arrow keys) to set the target.
On Quote builder, choose a stone and the room size: the floor fills with tiles, wastage shows as cut pieces, and Save quote adds a deal.
Filter, add, edit or delete stones in the Catalogue, export projects from Reports, and change settings, theme or reset the demo data.
